name: databricks
description: Read-only access to a Databricks workspace: ask Genie spaces business questions and run read-only SQL on a SQL warehouse. Needs the workspace address and a personal access token.

tools.name: databricks_check_connection
tools.description: Check the Databricks connection (host and token) and show who the token belongs to.

tools.name: databricks_list_genie_spaces
tools.description: List the Genie spaces of the workspace (id, title) so a question can go to the right one.

tools.name: databricks_ask_genie
tools.description: Ask a business question in natural language to a Databricks Genie space. Returns the answer text, the SQL Genie used and a result table.

tools.name: databricks_run_sql
tools.description: Run ONE read-only SQL statement (SELECT, WITH, SHOW, DESCRIBE, EXPLAIN) on a SQL warehouse. Writes are refused.

tools.name: databricks_describe_table
tools.description: Show the columns of a table (catalog.schema.table).

databricks_host.title: Workspace address
databricks_host.description: Example: https://adb-1234567890.1.azuredatabricks.net (copy it from the browser address bar of your workspace).

databricks_token.title: Personal access token
databricks_token.description: Databricks: your user icon, Settings, Developer, Access tokens, Generate new token. Stored as a secret, never written to config files.

warehouse_id.title: SQL warehouse id
warehouse_id.description: Optional. SQL Warehouses, open one, copy the id from the address bar or the Connection details tab. Needed for SQL questions.

genie_space_id.title: Default Genie space id
genie_space_id.description: Optional. The id at the end of the Genie space address. Without it the chat asks you which space or lists them.
